## Answer
I've mapped the impact of adding request telemetry across FastAPI routes and provider calls. The app already has OpenTelemetry infrastructure (app/main.py:12-24) with configure_telemetry() and instrument_fastapi_app(). Provider HTTP calls (anthropic, firecrawl, tavily) lack detailed telemetry. Edit targets: telemetry.py (add httpx instrumentation), 3 provider files (lines 101-109, 73-78, 93-98), and orchestrator nodes (search, fetcher). No test files found - high risk. Existing ProviderLogSink protocol ensures audit logging compatibility.
